gloss: official residence (of a head of state)

definitions.gloss: official residence (of a prime minister, governor, etc.)
definitions.explanation: The official residence provided to a high-ranking government official. In Japan, most commonly refers to the Prime Minister's Official Residence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧{官邸|かんてい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A press conference was held at the Prime Minister's official residence.

examples.japanese: {官邸|かんてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧⟦{隊|たい}→隊：03383_tai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Demonstrators gathered in front of the official residence.

examples.japanese: {官邸|かんてい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦{本部|ほんぶ}→本部：00112_honbu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧し、⟦{情報収集|じょうほうしゅうしゅう}→情報収集：27233_jouhoushuushuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: The official residence established an emergency task force and gathered information.

notes:
{官邸|かんてい} combines {官|かん} (government, official) and ⟦{邸|てい}→邸：23029_tei⟧ (mansion, residence).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧{官邸|かんてい} (Prime Minister's Official Residence)
- ⟦{知事|ちじ}→知事：03467_chiji⟧⟦{公邸|こうてい}→公邸：30126_koutei⟧ (governor's official residence — note: ⟦{公邸|こうてい}→公邸：30126_koutei⟧ is used for governors)
- {官邸|かんてい}⟦{筋|すじ}→筋：03366_suji⟧ (sources close to the PM's office)

USAGE:
In news media, {官邸|かんてい} by itself usually refers to the ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧{官邸|かんてい}. It can also be used metonymically to mean the prime minister or the prime minister's staff, similar to how "the White House" refers to the US president's administration.
